name: Chaz Merritt
title: Research Professional | ML & it's applications in forestry

highlights: Building machine learning models to forecast forest biometrics at national scale.
Developed Markov models to minimize risk in forestry management.
Published peer-reviewed papers at the intersection of AI and forestry.
Developed novel tools for removing subjectivity and automating the forest stand delineation process.
Gained hands on experience with timber cruising and forest inventory in the University of Idaho Experimental Forest.
Presented work at the Southern Forestry & GIS Conference on fine-tuning deep learning models for tree crown delineation.
Began acquiring the necessary domain knowledge to understand and solve problems in forestry.
